overall my recovery has been going very well but it's still moving very slowly, and honestly I kinda don't like to think about getting better and improving myself it feels a lot like I'm looking down on who I am and who I used to be. I mean I know I still have a lot of bad habits to correct and I still have way too much trouble with simple things like finding a summer job so I do know there are ways and reasons I have to change. But I know myself and I know who I am and who I was better than my parents or my therapist I mean they're nice and supportive but I hate having to look at myself and my past in such a negative light. I was of course by no means perfect and I had a lot of flaws, but honestly in most things I was trying my best and working very hard. I was clumsy and forgetful but I felt guilty about the mistakes I made and I was quiet and shy but honestly very lonely. And although I've accepted it's something I should never do I still can't see the fault in considering suicide I mean I never really asked for much from life I was willing to work hard and make compromises and all I wanted was the time to enjoy myself and relax but as I got older the price for this went up and the reward for the work went down at an exponential rate so honestly it's very simple and clear logic that lead me to the conclusion that life may not be worth living. Honestly I just want a life filled with meaning and joy but everyone else seems perfectly content with just being alive no matter how pointless and difficult life gets, personally if you ask me they're the ones who are emotionally and/or mentally unstable. But I digress suicide is no longer on the table as I realize, especially at this point in things, how it would affect the people around me. But when I at best am only resigned to being alive how am I supposed to find the motivation to live? I try my best to be open and considerate to the thoughts and feelings of others and do my best to consider and understand the perspectives of other people, but at many times I feel that those same people like my family for instance don't extend me the same courtesy. But regardless I have nowhere to go but forward so I must keep trying no matter what. Honestly I'd rather not change I prefer if someone could find me and accept me as flawed and troubled as I really am. That's infinitely more preferable than having to change and basically lie in order to interact with others find a career etc. I don't know but it's almost cruel to be expected to find a way to live in a world I know doesn't accept me
I'm doing a lot better, but I don't really know where to go from here...
